parole.testo: Inherited from Middle Persian [script needed] (ẕmstʾn' /⁠zamestān⁠/), borrowed from a Northwestern Iranian language, from Proto-Iranian *jimáh + *stā́nam. Cognate with Northern Kurdish zivistan, Ossetian зымӕг (zymæg), Avestan 𐬰𐬌𐬌𐬃 (ziiā̊), Latin hiems, Sanskrit हिम (himá), Pashto ژمی (žaməy) / Pash

From Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (špt'twk' /⁠šiftālūg⁠/, “peach”), a compound describing its texture of [Term?] (/⁠šift⁠/, “milk”) via Northwestern Iranian from Proto-Iranian *xšwiptah (“milk”) and [Book Pahlavi needed] (ʾlwk' /⁠ālūg⁠/, “plum”).
